## What does this PR do?

<!-- Describe WHAT changed and WHY — not how the code works -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — Code refactoring (no behavior change)
- [ ] `chore` — Dependencies, config, tooling
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation only
- [ ] `style` — Formatting, no logic change

## Skills Checklist

Before submitting, verify your changes respect the `.skills/` standards:

- [ ] **Folder Structure** — New files placed in the correct feature/domain folder
- [ ] **Security** — No secrets in code. No JWT in localStorage. All inputs validated.
- [ ] **Mobile First** — All new UI tested at 375px. Touch targets ≥ 48px. Uses `dvh` not `vh`.
- [ ] **Brand Originality** — No generic AI-look patterns. Colors use HSL custom properties.
- [ ] **Animations** — Only `transform` + `opacity` animated. `prefers-reduced-motion` handled.
- [ ] **Copy** — No AI clichés ("seamless", "empower", "next-generation").
- [ ] **Performance** — LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, JS bundle < 150kb first load.
- [ ] **Accessibility** — All interactive elements keyboard navigable. WCAG AA contrast.

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Tested on mobile (375px)
- [ ] Tested in dark mode
- [ ] Lighthouse score checked (if UI change)
